comment: Live Google Sheets spreadsheet IDs for the SALE/DISPATCH registers by fiscal year. These are goods-dispatched (primary sale) registers — NOT order-booking sheets. TWO SCHEMAS: Schema A (FY2026-27, 18-col): InvoiceNo, Date, BillFrom, CustomerName, City, Destination, ItemCode, Color, Qty, MRP, SaleRate, TaxableValue, GROUP, STATION, STATE, STATE HEAD, MONTH. Schema B (FY2024-25 and FY2025-26, 11-col per-monthly-tab): INVOICENO, DATE, BILLFROM, CUSTOMER, GROUP, CODE, COLOR, QTY, MRP, SALERATE, AMOUNT — no MONTH column; month is derived from the tab name (tabMonthLabel fix in sheetsRegister.ts). ITEMCOLOR and STATEHEADNAME aliases are present in normalize.ts. FY2023-24 sheet not yet configured here.

sap_source.comment: 15-column Combined SAP export (Posting Date, Document Number, Branch, Customer Name, Segment, Old Item Code, Description, Color, Quantity, PriceBefDi, Price After Discount, Taxable Amount, Total, GROUP, Month). Read-only. Used for tank qty fix and data-health SAP-lag check.
